title: Jack Dorsey’s Free AI Agent Changes Everything
description:
The #1 community for building a highly-profitable personal brand with AI and Claude Code.
👉 https://www.skool.com/buildroom/

Summary ⤵️

While everyone is debating Claude vs ChatGPT, a powerful open-source AI agent is flying under the radar.

It’s called Goose.

Built by the team at Block, Goose is designed to work with multiple AI models instead of locking you into a single provider.

Here’s why people are paying attention:

→ Works with Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, and more
→ Open source
→ Reads files and executes workflows
→ Helps automate coding tasks
→ No vendor lock-in

Setup is simple:

Install Goose
Connect your preferred model/API
Give it tasks in plain English

Reality check:

No AI agent is truly “set and forget.”
You still need to review outputs, especially for production code and business-critical tasks.

But if you want flexibility without being tied to one ecosystem, Goose is worth looking at.

Check my pinned comment below for the link 

#aitools #goose #claudeai #automation #coding
